intent: has(parent): presence of the to-one relation itself.

plannerDivergence.issue: has() over an omitted attribute: unknown to the planner, absent to check()
plannerDivergence.reason: Before 0.57.0 the planner folds has() to true, so the plan is KIND_ALWAYS_ALLOWED. The per-row check() calls omit parent on rows without a parent hop, so check() denies them. From 0.57.0 the plan carries the has().

trap: Rows with no parent hop must be denied; a translation that tests a parent column instead of the relation, or reads has() as always true, grants them.
